q.line: Saw me just come up with anger
stanza: In the car behind the carnival
My hand between your knees, you turned from me
And said, "The trapeze act was wonderful
But never meant to last", the clown that passed
Saw me just come up with anger
When it filled with circus dogs, the parking lot

partner.line: But never meant to last", the clown that passed

q.line: Or if you want to strike me down in anger
stanza: I'll do anything you ask me to
And if you want another kind of love
I'll wear a mask for you
Or if you want to strike me down in anger
